assumptions.statement: Official redlines and key-area polygons are not yet published; the package uses organizer provisional boundaries (site 1,141.3 ha, three key areas 192.9/104.3/72.0 ha recomputed). All geometry-derived metrics are provisional.
assumptions.impact: After official geometry is released, site_boundary, key_areas, land_use, roads, green_space, public_space, buildings, phasing, and all metrics must be recomputed end-to-end.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, engineering constraints) must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, and density metrics are status=unknown; no fabricated approved figures are presented.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are conceptual massing blocks inside the three key areas, not surveyed or approved schemes.
assumptions.impact: building_footprint_area_sqm and building_count are conceptual (confidence=low) and cannot be used as construction-scale evidence.

assumptions.statement: The Dazhongsi provisional range may deviate from the actual site location (community Issue #1029 raised the concern; the centroid may sit near Beijing North Station area).
assumptions.impact: Dazhongsi-area spatial conclusions are directional only; the design must be re-anchored after official key-area polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: Data-center waste-heat recovery and embodied-intelligence testing scenarios are conceptual; technical feasibility, energy economics, and local heating-network conditions require professional assessment and pilots.
assumptions.impact: Scenarios SC-03/SC-07/SC-11 are framed as test/validation concepts, not committed deployments.

assumptions.statement: OSM data (ODbL) is used only for directional context of roads, water systems, and park alignment; it is not a surveyed redline or blue line.
assumptions.impact: Road alignments and water lines are conceptual; professional survey data is required for engineering use.
